cue.definition:
n. an actor's line that immediately precedes and serves as a reminder for some action or speech
n. sports implement consisting of a tapering rod used to strike a cue ball in pool or billiards
cue.translation:
n. 提示, 线索
vt. 给...暗示(或提示)
[计] 尾接指令

cue ball.translation: n. （撞球）母球（以球杆击打的白色球）

cue mark.translation: [计] 指令标记, 提示标记

cued.definition: v assist (somebody acting or reciting) by suggesting the next words of something forgotten or imperfectly learned
cued.translation: v. 向…发出指示信号( cue的过去式和过去分词 )

cueing.definition: v assist (somebody acting or reciting) by suggesting the next words of something forgotten or imperfectly learned
cueing.translation: v. 向…发出指示信号( cue的现在分词 )

cueist.translation: n. (台球等的)用球杆者, 精于用球杆者

cuemid.translation: 降脂树脂Ⅰ号; 消胆胺

cuenca.translation: 昆卡(①厄瓜多尔城市 ②西班牙城市)

cuernavaca.translation: [地名] [墨西哥] 库埃纳瓦卡

cuervas.translation: (cuerva 的复数)  [地名] [西班牙] 奎尔瓦

cues.definition:
n an actor's line that immediately precedes and serves as a reminder for some action or speech
n evidence that helps to solve a problem
n a stimulus that provides information about what to do
n sports implement consisting of a tapering rod used to strike a cue ball in pool or billiards
v assist (somebody acting or reciting) by suggesting the next words of something forgotten or imperfectly learned
cues.translation: n. 开端, 线索；球杆；提示, 关键；诱因（cue的复数形式）

cuevas.translation: [人名] 奎瓦斯; [地名] [秘鲁、菲律宾、墨西哥] 奎瓦斯
